events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 326 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles southwest of
Gallup, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Two inch hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Gallup, Church Rock, Yah-Ta-Hey, Rock Springs, Fort Wingate, Red
Rock State Park, Allison, Gamerco and Mentmore.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 10 and 41.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Coconino, AZ
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 830 PM MST /930 PM MDT/ Tonight.

* At 226 PM MST /326 PM MDT/, repeated heavy rainfall from
thunderstorms across the region have caused a nearly 6 foot rise on
the Paria River, with additional rises reported well upstream.
Levels are falling at Lees Ferry, but are expected to rise again
later this afternoon and evening. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry and Vermilion Cliffs National Monument.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River and Paria River.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Mineral, CO; Rio Grande, CO; Saguache, CO
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Saguache, Central Mineral and Western Rio
Grande Counties...

* WHEN...Until 615 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Several
structures are flooded and some sand bagging operations are
continuing. Streams continue to rise due to excess runoff from
earlier rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 315 PM MDT, South Fork Fire reported heavy rain in the warned
area. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Del Norte, South Fork, Wagon Wheel Gap, Wolf Creek Pass and
Creede.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Apache, AZ; Coconino, AZ; Navajo, AZ
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 815 PM MST /915 PM MDT/ Tonight.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of creeks and normally dry washes is imminent or
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 210 PM MST /310 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain
due to thunderstorms. Flooding is already occurring in the warned
area. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Chinle Creek, Jeddito Wash, Nazlini Wash, Laguna Creek, Red Wash,
Dinnebito Wash, Moenkopi Wash, Steamboat Wash, Keams Canyon Wash
and Blackhorse Creek. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5
inches are possible in the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Chinle, Kayenta, Dilkon, Ganado, Kykotsmovi Village, Many Farms,
Lukachukai, Pinon, Tsaile, First Mesa, Leupp, Hotevilla-Bacavi,
Round Rock, Dennehotso, Chilchinbeto, Rough Rock, Shongopovi,
Keams Canyon and Teec Nos Pos.
- This includes the following swimming holes...
Clear Creek Reservoir.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
